result:
Perfect! **All tests pass.** The fix is complete. 

The issue was in `/tmp/h-bug_not_found-zugpmqef/invoicing/store.py`: the `get()` method was directly accessing `self._rows[invoice_id]`, which raises a `KeyError` for non-existent invoices. The API handler was catching `InvoiceError`, so the `KeyError` bubbled up and crashed the API.

The fix wraps the dictionary access in a try-except block to catch the `KeyError` and raise an `InvoiceError` with the "NOT_FOUND" code instead. This allows the API handler to properly catch it and return a 404 status code.
